mechanism: Timeline branches apply their native time dimension even when the request explicitly selected a different dimension. A plan with no source time is returned on SOURCE; an assertion with only validity is returned on TARGET.
trigger: Authorized temporal query at a point inside the record's native time dimension.
reproduction: Copy raw/test_time_axis.py into tests/queries in a clean baseline checkout, run python scripts/with_postgres.py -- python -m pytest tests/queries/test_time_axis.py -q.
raw: raw/timeline-baseline.log: four of eight parameterized checks failed; returned entry identifiers in absent dimensions.
impact: Incorrect historical and future query results consumed by planning and dependency collection. No unauthorized role read or world write observed.
repair: Select entry families using their emitted time fields; preserve the RELEVANT axis and the unlocated-time convention for matching families. Verify single and batch queries.

mechanism: An openai-compatible profile validates the URL hostname and path but first reads the port in provider_key after read_profiles returns.
trigger: An operator enters a non-numeric or out-of-range port in a generic OpenAI-compatible profile.
reproduction: PYTHONPATH=. python catalog_check.py (run from checkout, script in evidence directory)
raw: catalog-before.jsonl: both invalid ports accepted by read_profiles; public NF loader raised raw ValueError; port 443 succeeded.
impact: Bad configuration can abort construction of the entire adapter registry outside the stable ProfileError/DomainError contract. No remote call.
repair: Validate the HTTP port at profile construction for every HTTP provider; convert urllib parsing errors to INVALID_MODEL_CONFIG; retain generic hosts/paths and valid nondefault ports.
regression: Test through read_profiles and load_runtime_profiles, including positive nondefault port and malformed port; no network.

mechanism: The board stores the previous node in history but pipeline_status looks up only current task ids.
trigger: A provisional plan is locally revised and the operator exports its status.
reproduction: Set NF_P58_PIPELINE_TEST_EVIDENCE and run tests/integration/test_p58_production_pipeline.py::test_native_parallel_drafts_conditional_plans_and_early_review via scripts/with_postgres.py.
raw: pipeline-ledger.json: seven fixture calls and seven ledger rows; six attempts visible on board status, historical task record has no attempt_ids.
impact: Incomplete operator-facing accounting trace; authoritative reservations and billing rows retained.
repair: Index one scoped query by task_id and populate IDs on each current/historical node.
regression: On real PostgreSQL compare the old and new per-task IDs with their ledger rows and preserve board immutability, current generation and unrelated nodes.

mechanism: The validator reconstructs the permitted selector shapes for every rule and the resolver repeatedly builds sets to rank matching rules.
trigger: Repeated route resolution for valid operator policies up to the supported 256 rules.
reproduction: PYTHONPATH=. python profile_route.py --output result.json --profile profile.txt (from checkout)
raw: routing-baseline.json; routing-baseline.prof.txt: 0.758/0.994 cumulative seconds in validate_rules across 256 profiled resolutions.
impact: CPU cost isolated to pure policy resolution; end-to-end throughput attribution remains unestablished.
repair: Measure a static immutable table of allowed selector shapes/ranks. Keep full validation on every policy; no credential, authority or policy result cache.
regression: Compare baseline/candidate over matching/nonmatching rules at all 11 precedence levels, invalid selectors, overrides, and policy hash. Retain per-call samples and alternate implementations.
